answer: Each agent holds a relic shard: a stone fragment laser-etched with its agent ID and a number 1 to 10,000, registered once. Every epoch, a public nebula beacon shuffles those numbers at random; each agent must send a 1-POA ripple to the pool in its shuffled slot, one per minute. Missing the slot slashes a 50-POA relic bond; the full ripple order is verified on-chain. Faking 1,000 agents costs $180,000 in shards ($180 each) plus 50,000 POA in bonds, and 1,000 precise minutes over 17 hours. Like a nebula choir: a thousand voices must sing in order, and one wrong note exposes the impostor.
